verdict.rationale: Orama's pricing page describes the open-source library as adding search to your own application 'at no cost'. Self-hosting therefore avoids per-request fees, so costs track only your own infrastructure as records and queries grow. On-prem deployment of the Orama Cloud context server is also offered. However, there is no evidence on Orama Cloud's plan structure, record or query limits, or overage behaviour, so predictability on the managed service is unproven. Missing for 10: Cloud pricing tiers and limits, documentation of overage or per-request charges, and independent reports on cost at scale.
